name: nabard_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for NABARD livestock loan authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: nabard_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check eligibility. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: nabard_check_eligibility
description: Checks farmer's eligibility for NABARD livestock loan based on credit history, repayment capacity, and project feasibility. Returns eligibility_status with reasons. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if farmer has existing defaults, poor credit score, or project type is unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_submit_application
description: Submits a livestock loan application. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Requires session_token. Farmer must be eligible. Does NOT approve or disburse loan. Fails if farmer is ineligible, duplicate application exists, or required documents are missing.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_verify_documents
description: Initiates document verification for a submitted loan application. Transitions verification_status to 'in_progress'. Required documents include identity proof, land records, and project proposal. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve loan. Fails if application not submitted or documents are incomplete/invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the loan application.

name: nabard_track_application_status
description: Returns application_status ('not_applied', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected') with details. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify application. Fails if application_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_approve_loan
description: Records loan approval decision. Transitions loan_status to 'sanctioned' or application to 'rejected'. Approval depends on credit assessment and verification. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse loan. Fails if verification not completed or application already processed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_disburse_loan
description: Initiates loan disbursement to the farmer's bank account. Transitions loan_status to 'disbursed'. Loan must be 'sanctioned'. Requires session_token. Does NOT track repayment. Fails if loan not sanctioned, bank details invalid, or disbursement processing error.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

loan_id.description: Unique identifier of the sanctioned loan.

name: nabard_track_repayment
description: Tracks repayment_status ('not_started', 'ongoing', 'overdue', 'completed') with EMI details, amount paid, and remaining balance. Requires session_token. Does NOT process payments. Fails if loan_id is invalid or loan not yet disbursed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_track_loan_status
description: Returns current loan_status ('not_sanctioned', 'sanctioned', 'disbursed', 'active', 'closed', 'defaulted') with details. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify loan. Fails if loan_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_get_emi_schedule
description: Returns the full EMI schedule with due dates, amounts, and payment status for each installment. Requires session_token. Does NOT process payments. Fails if loan not disbursed or loan_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_calculate_loan_amount
description: Calculates eligible loan amount based on project type, cost, and farmer's repayment capacity. Returns maximum eligible amount and indicative EMI. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if project type unsupported or cost is unrealistic.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_handle_default
description: Records a default event when EMI payments are overdue beyond threshold. Transitions loan_status to 'defaulted'. Requires session_token. Does NOT restructure loan. Penalty may apply. Fails if loan is not in 'active' or 'overdue' status.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_restructure_loan
description: Initiates loan restructuring for a defaulted or overdue loan. May modify EMI amount, tenure, or interest terms. Requires session_token. Restructuring is NOT guaranteed and depends on bank assessment. Fails if loan is not defaulted/overdue or restructuring already attempted.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_close_loan
description: Closes a fully repaid loan. Transitions loan_status to 'closed'. All EMIs must be completed. Requires session_token. Does NOT refund or modify records. Fails if outstanding balance exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_raise_grievance
description: Raises a NABARD loan grievance. Categories: 'loan_rejected', 'disbursement_delay', 'repayment_issue', 'default_issue', 'documentation_issue'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: nabard_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks NABARD grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
